codeNodes.label: Gross I-Section Props
codeNodes.description: Welded unsymmetric I-section: A, y_bar, I_z, I_y, Z_e, Z_p (two-branch equal-area-axis search) and h_f. Port of the gross-property block of ltb_moment_capacity_welded().

codeNodes.label: Section Class IRC:24
codeNodes.description: IRC:24-2010 / IS 800:2007 classification of the compression flange and web (ε = √(250/fy)). section_type "welded" → 8.4/9.4/13.6ε outstand limits, anything else → rolled 9.4/10.5/15.7ε. Web limits 84/105/126ε.

codeNodes.label: Effective Section
codeNodes.description: EC3-style effective widths for slender plates (ε = √(235/fy), ψ = 1): outstand flange ρ·b and compression web ρ·d_comp, then A_eff, y_bar_eff, I_z_eff and Z_e_eff. Port of calculate_effective_section_properties().

codeNodes.label: LTB Design Capacity
codeNodes.description: IS 800:2007 / IRC:24 lateral-torsional buckling: M_cr, λ_LT = √(M_eff/M_cr), φ_LT and χ_LT from curve c (α 0.49) or d (α 0.76), f_bd = χ_LT·fy/γm0, then M_d and the laterally-supported M_d. λ_LT ≤ 0.4 → LTB does not govern. class_override "auto" reproduces section_class=None.
